additional_findings: Questions during name/review collection could become field values or restart intake.
Email save consent incorrectly described as email transmission in some replies.
Unsupported blanket claims about changing or reopening a delivered record.
Several greetings/request-free messages unnecessarily introduced tracking.
Multiple correction fields required preserving both and reviewing only requested fields.
Natural cancellation and contact preference changes required frontend handling.
Legacy saved-update acknowledgements used unsolicited jokes regardless of distress.
fixes: Scoped positive contact intent; negated calls and process questions stay conversational.
Staff correspondence separate from saved request; no sent email/call claims.
Missing delivery number alternatives without restarting verification.
Concise action acknowledgement; no internal workflow labels.
Contact clarification preserves step, values and request reference.
Email-first intake, natural withdrawal, bilingual preference switching.
Requested correction fields collected once and explicitly reviewed; backend verifies before saving pending request.
Reverification resumes original action and requested correction fields.
No canned joke on correction save.
remaining_launch_checks: Real authorized passenger delivery verification and staff handling of saved requests require final operational acceptance before October 15.
